creator: Alexander Terp
description: From tooling feedback, 2026-10-15, 0.16.0: restarting a dozen agents by hand (a_2dmIEdCn6) meant reading each one's session id and flags out of `/proc` and the harness's own files. `muster window --json` gives a pane's agent model, context and cost, but not the session id its adapter reported or the command line it runs. The daemon already holds both: the adapter's hooks report the session, and the resume path reads the flags off the running process (a_2YXWVPfDI). Putting them on the pane's record, as something like `session` and `command`, would let an agent or a script resume, restart or hand over a session without digging. The 2026-10-16 recovery of two stuck Codex panes on a_2dmIEdCn6 needed the same id.
title: muster window --json does not give an agent's session id or the command it was started with
